verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents cancelling, voiding, reversing or editing a payroll after it has been submitted and before payday. The AI-enabled error flagging catches mistakes before submission, which is an adjacent feature rather than post-submission cancellation or correction. Payroll cancellation is a fair question for a payroll product, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can cancel or correct a submitted payroll before employees are paid
